notes.title: Global Update
notes.content:
• Updated the balance of the game.
• The game interface has been updated.
• Added alerts about actions.
• Updated casino functionality.
• Added sounds.
• The interface of game events has been changed.
• Added the mechanics of product validity.
• Improved optimization.
• Improved the mechanics of happiness.
• Fixed a bug related to the screen resolution.
• Achievements related to the survival mode have been removed.

notes.title: A new character has been added to the game
notes.content:
Alexander was born in a family of a successful businessman. His father built a large construction company, so the family didn't need anything. After finishing a good school, Sasha put his parents in front of the fact: he will build his own life and refuses financial support of his parents
Game interface changes
Added animations between scenes
Improved optimization
Closing "survival" mode, developing "career" mode
We decided to remove the survival mode. In the upcoming update, a new mode will appear - a career mode for each of the characters

notes.title: Panko M.D.
notes.content:
Friends, it's time for a major update! 
We have worked hard to make the game more beautiful, interesting and rich

[b]Interface:[/b]
•Full redesign of the main menu.
Added new "news" and "achievements" tabs.

[b]Economy:[/b]
* Redesigned salary system and pricing policy in the game.

And like the cherry on the cake,
[b]New character:[/b]

Panko M.D.

"He was born in the family of the metallurgical plant director in the city of N. Despite the high wealth of his family, Anton grew up quiet and assiduous child, who knows the words work and diligence. He didn’t have many friend, most likely because of his modesty. One day everything changed – Anton met Nikolai – his truly best friend. Nikolai lived on the floor above, and their parents knew each other, so their friendship was only encouraged. Nikolai was a ringleader; without whom nothing took place. He was the only one, who helped Anton to overcome his insularity. Anton wanted to follow in the footsteps of his grandfather and become a surgeon, believing that this way he would not only be able to realize his own ambitions, but also to help people.

Great wealth of experience and general characteristics, also his father's connections, allowed Anton to get a job at the central hospital in the city of N.. Here, in his native quiet city of N, begins a new chapter of Anton's life....."

[b]There are also discounts on our game[/b]
Before April 31, hurry up to buy the game at a 30% discount.

notes.title: Scheduled update after the test
notes.content:
[b]•Shop:[/b]

Now the store consists not only of 3 types of food - healthy, normal and junk, but includes specific products at a specific cost. Each item will have an expiration date, points for restoring the character's health and emotional state.

[b]•Fridge:[/b]

Now in the characters' apartment, the refrigerator will not function as an intermediary between the character and the store, but will respond to its main task - storing products in it.

[b]•Flea market:[/b]

In General, the flea market will work as shop, but with some other gaming laws. Don't worry — you can still buy a new TV.

[b]•Tax and salary systems:[/b]

Now you will have the opportunity to understand how and in what way you need to spend your money. This problem was clearly reflected by the testers, who stressed that with the previous version of the economy in the game it was difficult to understand how money appeared and where it disappeared.

[b]•Card game:[/b]

The entertainment section has also changed. Now the opportunity to earn money is not based on randomness, but on the actual skill of the player in card games. 

[b]•New character:[/b]

We are working on creating the story of the second character, so in the near future after the release, he will have to add to the list of heroes of the game.
